stem: Adil compares the two-term ratios 3 : 7 and 6 : 14.

options.text: They are proportional even if the second ratio is read as 14 : 6.
They are proportional because both ratios mention corresponding terms.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Corresponding terms match when the cross products are equal: 3×14 and 7×6 are both 42, so the ratios are proportional in the stated order.

teacher.key_rationale: Cross-multiply in the stated order. Reading 14:6 drops order. Merely mentioning corresponding terms is not a check.
